_comment: Single source of truth for OpenClaw unit economics. Edit this, not code.
_min_net_comment: Floor derived from KDP's best case: $9.99 ebook nets ~$6.89. Setting floor at $6.00 admits that price point while rejecting genuinely weak margins.

kdp_ebook._tier_note: First matching tier wins. The 70% tier requires price within 2.99-9.99 inclusive. All other prices fall to 35%.
kdp_ebook._delivery_note: KDP deducts delivery cost only on the 70% tier.

kdp_paperback._print_note: US marketplace, black ink, white paper. Approximate. Verify against KDP printing cost calculator before trusting.

gumroad_digital._note: Gumroad takes 10% on Gumroad-discovered sales. Simplified.
gumroad_digital._floor_note: ADR-020: separate, lower profit floor than the global $6.00 (calibrated for KDP ebooks) — printables have near-zero marginal cost and this floor exists specifically to allow the president's approved $3-5 launch pricing (net $2.70-$4.50 at 90% royalty) while still rejecting near-zero prices. Decided explicitly by the president, not inferred.

kdp_ebook._reason: Any ebook priced in this band nets LESS per unit than a $9.99 ebook (which earns 70%), while also selling less. Strictly dominated. Break-even vs $9.99 occurs at $19.69.

demand_model._note: No sales data. Any price recommendation is speculation. Populate from finance_data.json once real sales exist.
